name: brigade
description: Team messaging between the coding sessions of different people and machines: Codex CLI sessions beside Claude Code and Muse Code ones, through a pluggable adapter CLI (Supabase adapter bundled).

interface.shortDescription: Message the coding sessions of your teammates, whichever harness they use.
interface.longDescription: Brigade connects the coding sessions of different people and machines in one team: a Codex session sends a message to a teammate's Claude Code, Muse Code or Codex session and receives theirs, and people without a session take part by email or Slack. One team, one backend your organisation owns.
defaultPrompt: Tell the teammate working on the API that the migration has landed
